subject.title: Request: delete stale plugin entries claw-pay-plugin (v0.27, v0.25) from Publisher Plugins

question: Should any current `claw-pay-plugin` production rows be deleted now that the originally requested `0.27` and `0.25` versions return 404 and the live package exposes `0.2.7` and `0.2.6`?
rationale: Deleting or hiding plugin package rows changes executable registry trust/listing state, and the public API no longer matches the exact target versions from the report.

options.title: Reverify and delete only confirmed stale rows
options.body: Use production/admin views or publisher confirmation to identify exact stale release records, then delete only those records through audited lifecycle tooling.

options.title: Leave current package intact
options.body: If `0.2.7` and `0.2.6` are the intended current releases, keep the package visible and ask the publisher to confirm there are no stale visible rows left.

options.title: Close after obsolete-target confirmation
options.body: If maintainers confirm the originally requested rows no longer exist anywhere visible or actionable, close this issue as obsolete cleanup rather than deleting by package name.

recommendation.title: Reverify and delete only confirmed stale rows
recommendation.body: Use production/admin views or publisher confirmation to identify exact stale release records, then delete only those records through audited lifecycle tooling.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest source/history tie to the package lifecycle tooling and recently handled related `claw-pay` scan-state cleanup context.
